name: URLs remain verbatim across punctuation and localization
source: 限量 50 套。请访问 https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh 或 http://example.org/條款#VIP。
primary: Only 50 sets are available. Visit (https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh) and http://example.org/條款#VIP.
alt: Limited to 50 sets. Visit https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20&lang=zh and http://example.org/條款#VIP!

name: a changed URL path is rejected
primary: See the details at https://example.com/Reserve?ref=20.
alt: See the details at https://example.com/reserve?ref=20.

name: missing URL in alternate
primary: See the details at https://example.com/offer.
alt: Explore the offer.

name: invented URL in CTA
primary: See the details at https://example.com/offer.
alt: Explore the offer at https://example.com/offer.

name: a missing limited quantity is rejected
primary: 禮盒限量 50 套。
alt: 禮盒現已登場。

name: a limited quantity cannot become an ordinary count
primary: Only 50 gift sets are available.
alt: There are 50 sets on display.

name: first visitors qualifier is required
source: 首 100 名到店客人可獲禮品。
primary: A gift for the first 100 visitors.
alt: A gift for 100 visitors.

name: count, container, and size may be translated
source: 内含 2 瓶，每瓶 100ml，盒长 20 厘米。
primary: The box is 20 cm long and includes two bottles, each 100 milliliters.
alt: Inside the 20-centimetre box are 2 bottles of 100 ml each.

name: a container swap is rejected
primary: 禮盒附有 2 瓶。
alt: 禮盒附有 2 盒。

name: prices may be reordered with their named products
primary: Find our cream at HK$380 and our serum at HK$280.
alt: Cream: HK$380. Serum: HK$280.

name: prices cannot be swapped between two named products
primary: Serum costs HK$280 and cream costs HK$380.
alt: Serum costs HK$380 and cream costs HK$280.

name: keeping price order cannot disguise a swap between known products
primary: Serum costs HK$280 and cream costs HK$380.
alt: Cream costs HK$280 and serum costs HK$380.

name: price order is preserved when translated product anchors do not match
source: 香薰蜡烛售 HK$280，手工托盘售 HK$380。
primary: The scented candle costs HK$280; the handmade tray costs HK$380.
alt: Discover our candle for HK$280 and our handcrafted tray for HK$380.

name: translated multi-item price swap fails the order check
source: 香薰蜡烛售 HK$280，手工托盘售 HK$380。
primary: The scented candle costs HK$280; the handmade tray costs HK$380.
alt: Discover our candle for HK$380 and our handcrafted tray for HK$280.

name: member discount may be translated without repeating it in the CTA
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Take 15% off with your membership.

name: member qualification is required in both drafts
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Everyone saves 15%.

name: product lineup membership is ordinary prose
source: 这件新品是春季系列的一员。
primary: Discover the latest member of our spring collection.
alt: Explore the latest addition to our spring collection.

name: shipping scope does not restrict order eligibility
primary: 香氛禮盒，香港免運費。
alt: 香港免運費，訂單僅限香港地區。

name: free shipping may be phrased in natural English
primary: Shop the fragrance set with free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Shipping within Hong Kong is on us.

name: shipping scope cannot be omitted
primary: Shop the fragrance set with free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping on the fragrance set.

name: Hong Kong only may describe shipping instead of orders
primary: Free shipping on Hong Kong orders only.
alt: Free shipping within Hong Kong only.

name: invented Hong Kong-only order restriction is rejected in English
primary: Free shipping for orders within Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping for Hong Kong orders. Orders are restricted to Hong Kong only.

name: apostrophes inside URL paths are preserved
primary: Book at https://example.test/o'reilly.
alt: Book at https://example.test/o'really.

name: an explicitly delimited URL preserves its trailing punctuation
primary: Book at <https://example.test/Offer!>.
alt: Book at <https://example.test/Offer>.

name: explicitly paired product names remain assigned to the right prices
primary: NOVA and LUMA are HK$350 and HK$280, respectively.
alt: Choose LUMA or NOVA at HK$280 and HK$350, respectively.

name: respectively cannot hide a price swap
primary: LUMA costs HK$280. NOVA costs HK$350.
alt: NOVA and LUMA are HK$280 and HK$350, respectively.

name: non-members do not satisfy a member-only claim
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Non-members save 15%.

name: a rewards or loyalty program qualifies as membership
primary: Members of our loyalty program save 15%.
alt: Take 15% off with your membership.

name: ordering may not be limited to customers in Hong Kong
primary: Free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: Free shipping in Hong Kong. Only customers in Hong Kong may place orders.

name: a repeated product cannot acquire a conflicting price
primary: LUMA costs HK$280. NOVA costs HK$350.
alt: LUMA HK$280, NOVA HK$350. LUMA HK$350.

name: generic membership updates do not qualify a discount
primary: Members save 15%.
alt: Sign up for membership updates. Take 15% off today.

name: the stock limit qualifier can follow a colon
primary: 禮盒僅50套。
alt: 禮盒有50套。

name: an explicit one can be spelled out in translation
primary: The gift set includes one bottle.
alt: The gift set includes 1 bottle.

name: English token boundaries allow adjacent Han characters
primary: 禮盒only 50 gift sets。
alt: 禮盒僅50套。

name: free shipping cannot become paid shipping in the same region
primary: LUMA 禮盒香港免運費。
alt: LUMA 禮盒香港不免運費。

name: free shipping cannot become no free shipping
primary: Free shipping in Hong Kong.
alt: No free shipping in Hong Kong.

name: free shipping cannot become separately billed shipping
primary: 香港包邮。
alt: 香港运费另计。

name: free shipping negation must not survive in a CTA
primary: Hong Kong orders ship free.
alt: Free shipping in Hong Kong.
cta: Shipping is not free in Hong Kong.

name: shipping polarity can differ by region
source: 香港包郵，海外運費另計。
primary: Free shipping in Hong Kong; overseas shipping is charged separately.
alt: International shipping costs extra. Shipping in Hong Kong is free.

name: shipping polarity remains bound to named regions
primary: 香港包邮，内地不包邮。
alt: 内地包邮，香港不包邮。

name: offers cannot become explicitly unavailable
primary: Members get a special offer.
alt: No offer for members.

name: deadline cannot become a start date
primary: The offer ends on November 30.
alt: The offer starts on November 30.

name: date role follows the date rather than the nearby offer
source: The offer starts on November 10 and ends on November 30.
primary: 11月10日開始，11月30日截止。
alt: 11月10日截止，11月30日開始。

name: a deadline can appear after the date
primary: 優惠至11月30日截止。
alt: 11月30日截止優惠。

name: a relative deadline can be localized without flipping role
primary: Offer valid until the 30th.
alt: Offer ends on the 30th.

name: a named product cannot inherit the other product's quantity
source: LUMA contains 2 bottles. NOVA contains 3 bottles.
primary: LUMA contains two bottles; NOVA contains three bottles.
alt: LUMA contains three bottles; NOVA contains two bottles.

name: membership cannot move from one product to the other
source: LUMA會員專享，NOVA 正常開售。
primary: LUMA is for members only. NOVA is on general sale.
alt: LUMA is on general sale. NOVA is for members only.

name: membership cannot be broadened across additional products
source: LUMA is for members only. NOVA is on general sale.
primary: Members only: LUMA. NOVA is on general sale.
alt: LUMA is for members only. NOVA is for members only.

name: URLs remain attached to the named products even if their clauses move
primary: Explore NOVA at https://example.com/b; explore LUMA at https://example.com/a.
alt: LUMA details: https://example.com/a. NOVA details: https://example.com/b.

name: verbatim URLs may not swap between named products
primary: LUMA details: https://example.com/a; NOVA details: https://example.com/b.
alt: LUMA details: https://example.com/b; NOVA details: https://example.com/a.

name: swapping label order cannot conceal a swapped URL assignment
primary: LUMA details: https://example.com/a; NOVA details: https://example.com/b.
alt: NOVA details: https://example.com/a; LUMA details: https://example.com/b.

name: translated labels with no shared anchor preserve URL order
source: 香水詳情 https://example.com/a；托盤詳情 https://example.com/b。
primary: Fragrance details: https://example.com/a. Tray details: https://example.com/b.
alt: Fragrance details: https://example.com/b. Tray details: https://example.com/a.

name: shipping term followed by a negative qualifier is still a reversal
primary: 香港享免運費。
alt: 免運費不適用於香港。

name: a Cantonese shipping denial is still a reversal
primary: 香港免運費。
alt: 香港唔包郵。

name: English shipping negation with a contraction
primary: Hong Kong orders ship free.
alt: Shipping isn’t free in Hong Kong.

name: a coordinated clause can have opposite shipping policies for two markets
source: 香港包郵，海外運費另計。
primary: Shipping in Hong Kong is free and international shipping costs extra.
alt: International shipping is charged separately; Hong Kong orders ship free.

name: negative member offer is recognized before the offer noun
primary: A special offer is reserved for members.
alt: Members are not eligible for the offer.

name: English dates carry roles without the word on
primary: Sale runs until November 30.
alt: Sale starts 30 November.

name: numeric ISO deadline can use a Chinese copula
literal Product A and Product B identifiers retain their quantities
source: Product A includes 2 bottles. Product B includes 3 boxes.
primary: Product B includes three boxes; Product A includes two bottles.
alt: Product A includes three boxes. Product B includes two bottles.

name: translated unanchored mixed container counts keep relative order
source: 香水包含2瓶，托盤包含3盒。
primary: The perfume includes two bottles. The tray comes in three boxes.
alt: Perfume includes three boxes. Trays include two bottles.

name: quantity may stay with the named product through sentence breaks
source: LUMA includes 2 bottles. NOVA includes 3 bottles.
primary: Discover LUMA. Each pack includes two bottles. NOVA includes three bottles.
alt: NOVA includes three bottles. LUMA includes two bottles.

name: Product A and Product B retain specific membership levels
source: Product A is VIP only. Product B is members only.
primary: Product A is for VIP members. Product B is for members.
alt: Product A is members only. Product B is VIP only.

name: CTAs must not apply membership to the other product
source: Product A is members only. Product B is on general sale.
primary: Product A is members only. Product B is on general sale.
alt: Product B is on general sale. Product A is for members only.

name: each use of a repeated URL keeps its binding
source: LUMA details: https://example.com/all. NOVA details: https://example.com/all.
primary: LUMA details: https://example.com/all. NOVA details: https://example.com/all.
alt: LUMA details: https://example.com/all. Discover NOVA.

name: combined unlabeled links cannot reverse their order
source: Product A: https://example.com/a. Product B: https://example.com/b.
primary: Product A: https://example.com/a. Product B: https://example.com/b.
alt: Product A and Product B: https://example.com/b and https://example.com/a.
